test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On : 3 March 2023)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements is/are correct regarding the changes made to small savings schemes by the Government of India in December 2022?

A. The interest rate of five year National Saving Certificate has been increased to 7 per cent from 6.8 per cent.

B. The interest rate on senior citizen saving schemes increased to 8.2 per cent from 7.6 per cent.

C. The interest rate on Public Provident Fund, Sukanya Samriddhi Account and Saving Deposit have been changed 9% from 7.5%
solution:
Correct answer **A and B only**

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] In News__

__
 
• The Centre raised the interest rates on small savings schemes in April 2023.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points:__**

__
 
• The rate of interest has been increased by 70 basis points which will be applicable from April 1, 2023.
 
• The revised interest rate is not applicable to the Public Provident Fund (PPF) scheme.
 
• The interest rates for popular PPF and savings deposits have been retained at 7.1 percent and 4 percent, respectively.
